title: ExtendoJump
description: left click with the extendo-grip in one hand and nothing in the other to push off a surface and get a jump boost. requires neoforge 21.1.231 (i made this for me no idea what im doing).
body: Left click the a surface to get a velocity boost in the oposite direction. works with the extendo-grip in one hand and nothing in the other. doesnt work on curved create train tracks. requires neoforge 21.1.231 and create.
